rows.text: its step-down subsidiary Raghukul Shradha Realty executes two sale deeds to acquire property in Nagpur for a total of **Rs 35.71 crore**

**Shradha Realty** (SHRADHA) — step-down LLP **Raghukul Shradha Realty executes an Agreement to Sell to acquire a Nagpur property (NIT leasehold plot, Civil Station Expansion Scheme) for Rs 17.86 cr** (~6.3% of mcap), for real-estate development.
